description: A calm desktop wallpaper until the music starts: then it turns into a stage, with a background that moves to the beat in the colors of the album cover and the lyrics of the song line by line, in sync (karaoke, word by word or whole lines). Back to the wallpaper when the music stops. Lyrics are looked up online on LRCLIB from the song that Wallpaper Engine reports: turn on "Media integration" in its settings. Use the built-in wallpapers or your own image.

ar-sa.ui_importcode: Import code (generated in the browser menu)
ar-sa.ui_lyricanim_karaoke: Karaoke (the line fills as it is sung)
ar-sa.ui_lyriccontext: Show the previous and next lines
ar-sa.ui_lyricoffset: Timing adjustment (seconds; raise it if the lyrics come too early)
ar-sa.ui_note_idle: Original artwork in the style of the Windows wallpapers. For the real one, pick "My image" and choose C:\Windows\Web\Wallpaper\Windows\img0.jpg.
ar-sa.ui_note_lyrics: Lyrics are looked up online (lrclib.net) from the song title and artist that Wallpaper Engine reports. Turn on "Media integration" in the Wallpaper Engine settings.
ar-sa.ui_note_theme: The theme is the base. Any option below that you change takes priority over it.
ar-sa.ui_returndelay: Back to the wallpaper after a pause of (seconds)
ar-sa.ui_showcolor: Color when there is no album cover
ar-sa.ui_showcover: Album cover next to the title
ar-sa.ui_songcard_corner: At the start, then in a corner
ar-sa.ui_songcard_start: Only at the start of the song
ar-sa.ui_trigger_media: Only when a player reports a song
ar-sa.ui_trigger_sound: Whenever there is sound for a few seconds
